column1: # The Arkansas Administrative Office of the Courts' circuit judge directory,
# https://arcourts.gov/directories/circuit-judges, read 2026-10-16 with this project's own client, districtry/1.0 (+https://districtry.com/ar/), after reading robots.txt,
# which permits the path. Page: 801349 bytes, SHA-256 dbf01ffd7c928aeb9b46961386f390971d72784caafe5629a1aa528d6f7a6704.
# The page has one table per county (75), and in it one row for each circuit
# judge who serves that county, naming the judge's circuit and division (373
# rows). This file keeps, for each county, its circuit as the directory writes
# it and the division numbers that serve it. It does NOT keep the judges'
# names, addresses or telephone numbers, which this project does not publish
# county <TAB> circuit, as the directory writes it <TAB> divisions serving the county
